metadata.title: Nvidia Stock: How $14B Hugging Face Acquisition Could Secure Its AI Dominance<!-- --> - Barron's

content.text:
Why Is Nvidia Willing to Pay $14 Billion for Hugging Face?
Nvidia executives insist the company is much more than a chip supplier. A move to buy artificial-intelligence development platform Hugging Face for about $14 billion might sway the market toward their line of thinking.
